subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open dirty fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close/supersede that path and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open fork PR with closing syntax is dirty and unmerged, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then let a new current-main Control UI fix address this issue with tests and visual proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, repair it against the current Debug page split, and provide real behavior proof before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the dirty fork PR, then let a new current-main Control UI fix address this issue with tests and visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Debug controller/view behavior introduced in the Control dashboard work.
